subject.title: feat(message): list chat / list messages should support pagination instead of hardcoded 25 limit

question: Should OpenClaw define one shared message-action pagination contract now, or split the remaining work into provider-specific pagination follow-ups after the formatter fix?
rationale: Source inspection proves the remaining gap, but choosing a durable API across Discord offset pagination and token/nextLink providers is a product/API boundary decision rather than a safe automated bug fix.

options.title: Define Shared Contract
options.body: Add a shared cursor/page contract for message actions and implement the highest-impact provider paths behind that contract.

options.title: Split By Provider
options.body: Keep this issue as planning context and open narrower follow-ups for Discord search offset, Teams Graph nextLink, and Feishu pageToken behavior.

options.title: Stop At Partial Fix
options.body: Close the broader request after the formatter fix and accept that multi-page iteration remains unavailable in the message CLI/tool surface.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared cursor/page contract for message actions and implement the highest-impact provider paths behind that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person reopened the issue after the partial fix and stated the remaining pagination boundary most clearly.
